text: Soon they saw a woman. <break time="0.8s" /> Hobbling along the path. <break time="0.8s" /> And Brown recognized Goody Cloyse. <break time="0.8s" /> A pious old lady. <break time="0.8s" /> Who had taught him his catechism in youth. <break time="0.8s" /> And was still his spiritual adviser. <break time="0.8s" /> Ashamed to be seen. <break time="0.8s" /> With such a companion. <break time="0.8s" /> Brown hid among the trees. <break time="0.8s" /> While the traveler went forward. <break time="0.8s" /> And touched her withered neck. <break time="0.8s" /> With what seemed the serpents tail. <break time="0.8s" /> The devil, screamed the old lady. <break time="0.8s" /> But instead of running away. <break time="0.8s" /> She greeted him warmly. <break time="0.8s" /> As an old friend. <break time="0.8s" /> And complained. <break time="0.8s" /> That someone had stolen her broomstick. <break time="0.8s" /> She added that she was going to the meeting that night. <break time="0.8s" /> Where, it was said. <break time="0.8s" /> A nice young man. <break time="0.8s" /> Was to be taken into communion. <break time="0.8s" /> The traveler threw down his staff. <break time="0.8s" /> At her feet. <break time="0.8s" /> And the old woman vanished in an instant. <break time="0.8s" /> Leaving Brown astonished. <break time="0.8s" /> That his own teacher. <break time="0.8s" /> Was going to such a meeting. <break time="0.8s" /> As they walked on the traveler made a new staff. <break time="0.8s" /> From a maple branch. <break time="0.8s" /> And its twigs withered and dried up. <break time="0.8s" /> The moment his fingers touched them. <break time="0.8s" /> Not another step will I budge. <break time="0.8s" /> On this errand. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Brown stubbornly. <break time="0.8s" /> Sitting down on a stump. <break time="0.8s" /> For why should I leave my dear Faith. <break time="0.8s" /> Because an old woman goes to the devil. <break time="0.8s" /> Saying that Brown would think better of it. <break time="0.8s" /> By and by the traveler threw him the maple staff. <break time="0.8s" /> And was out of sight. <break time="0.8s" /> As if he had vanished. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the deepening gloom.
